[quote=kaaganika;60041411][nation]Bantarus[/nation] what does an Associate Member of EDU do?[/quote]
Article 7: Associate Membership
7.1 Sovereign states that are located within the continental sphere of Elseyr, or which maintain cultural, historical, or strategic ties to its peoples, may apply for Associate Membership.
7.2 Associate Members must commit to the principles of mutual defense, civilizational continuity, and the sovereign dignity of the nation-state.
7.3 Associate Members shall:
  a. Receive strategic guarantees from the EDU Defense Althing.
  b. Participate in joint military exercises, intelligence sharing, technological exchanges, and crisis planning.
  c. Be eligible for full membership upon ratification by the EDU Althing.
7.4 Associate status may be granted or revoked by a two-thirds majority vote of the EDU Althing.

[b]NEUDRESDEN GAZETTE: WAR WITH BOBIAN REPUBLICS OVER[/b]

[i]Bobian Elseyran Exclave, August 1, 2025[/i]On Friday following days of negotiations between Bobian and Kaiserreich officials an agreement was reached to end the conflict. The Büdingen Accords have established the terms of the peace between the two states involving land transfers, economic benefits and political assurances. This agreement comes after almost a month of war in the south resulting in heavy civilian casualties, military occupation of parts of the Bobian territory, and missile exchanges. Almost 1,500 Reichswehr servicemen have been killed in the war so far along with 400 injured. Fortunately civilian casualties for Kaiserreich citizens were largely averted with large scale evacuations from the south before the beginning of the war. 

According to the released and finalized version of the Büdingen Accords several concessions were made. In exchange for the transfer of the Bobian Elseyran exclave to the Kaiserreich, the southern Kaiserreich territory of Braun will be exchanged to the Bobians. The Kaiserreich has also agreed to move to extend the EDU trade charter to the Bobians as well as allowing Bobian military assets to remain in the former BEE. Resource extraction by the Bobians will also be permitted to continue. 

[nation]BR Bob[/nation]
